svg.title: Exterior Recovery Yard / spatial blockout
svg.text: N ↑ 4-tile grid white: circulation dark: hull / terrain mass
Dashed: initial40×22.5 view. Open circle: operating approach. Dot: incoming spawn.
Recover storm-damaged station infrastructure after diagnosis, using bounded attainable
work and explicit utility information. Mast footing, shielded service trench, fenced
compounds and a pressure-safe airlock apron.
Landmark: Mast 04 / damaged upper arm. Quiet space: sheltered apron /
static weather. Beyond initial view: Mast is the anchor near arrival;
scanner plot and recovery compound extend north, requiring separate trips
Main spine4 tiles/128 px; secondary and doors3 tiles/96 px. Actual player32×42 px.
Footprint blocks only its visible base; overhead cap uses an authored contact anchor.
Camera clamped to room, never to task result.
Crew state: Static weather screen partly folded at apron edge. Crew secures
screen without changing apron illumination. M23 absolute cols16–22/rows8–13
retained, targets A18,9/B20,12; no coordinate remapping. M24 rig/tray
offsets and M26 pair relative geometry preserved; engine parameters
untouched. Long travel occurs before starting primary windows. Turn and
Thaw remain commands at coupling; rack decorative. M24 pad is translated
with rig; M26 panel/A offset(4,-1), B/A(6.5,1). M24/M26 alternatives and
retries remain usable until Noor finished outside or Utility review;
Static weather screen partly folded at apron
Crew secures screen without changing apron
Protected unchanged: M05 salience, all compound geometry, M23 plot/targets and post-knowledge alternatives
Original analytical blockout • labels are reviewer annotations • no commercial-game imagery
